# Tennerife Tennis Retreat

> Private tennis retreat on Tenerife for ambitious people. 7 days of tennis and padel, villa with chef, ocean, lifestyle and networking. 18–24 October 2026. 14 spots.

Tennerife Tennis Retreat is a curated week-long retreat that combines daily training at Tenerife Tennis Academy with a shared villa, full board, and a small group of entrepreneurs and ambitious amateurs. Pricing: €1950 (camp €1350 + villa €600). Flight (~€900) and Schengen visa (~€200) are paid separately. Language: Russian.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the retreat — programme, villa, team, pricing, FAQ and application form.
- [Season 02 waitlist](/season-02): Waitlist for the autumn 2027 edition; participants get early access two weeks before public sale.
- [Public contract](/contract): Offer agreement covering services, pricing, payment and refund terms (100% refund if the camp does not happen).
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): How personal data from the application form is processed.
